$comment: Skill names a contract may record (contracts 2.9.0). The enum lists the seven current names, then the four deprecated names of the hep-research 0.11.0 rename (hep-analysis -> hep-measurement, detector-response -> hep-detector, research-communication -> hep-communication, physics-ml -> hep-ml). A deprecated name passes the schema; contracts.skill_names reports it (warning, or an error under --strict-versions and protected use), and contracts/migrate_skill_names.py rewrites it. Keep in step with contracts/skill_names.py.
